text.value: That is how people decide now. They look you up, see how many students and readers vouch for you, and compare. If you have eleven reviews and the next person has two hundred, you were never in the running, no matter who teaches better. So we build the thing that asks for you. Every client and student gets a short check-in while the program is still going, so you hear about a problem while you can still fix it, not in a public review on Saturday. And the moment someone tells you they're happy, they're asked to say so publicly. Every client, every time, without anyone remembering. Those reviews go on the website we build for you, beside your own e-book and your own podcast.

text.label: Text: How the funnel works
Heading: Ask everyone, every time, without rememberin…
text.value: Your AI employee works as your client success manager and stays in touch with every student and client from the day they enrol to the day they finish.

text.label: Text: 01
Heading: The visit finishes
text.value: You check in while the program is still going

text.label: Text: The system knows it is finished, because it…
text.value: A short survey at the points that matter, not one message weeks after they finished. It goes out on its own, because it is watching the program calendar and the payments rather than somebody's memory.

text.label: Text: 02
Heading: The ask goes out
text.value: You hear the problems while they are still fixable

text.label: Text: A short, human message at the right moment —…
text.value: If somebody is unhappy, you know the same day and you can put it right with a phone call. That is the whole reason to ask early instead of once at the end.

text.label: Text: 03
Heading: Every customer gets the same ask
text.value: Happy students get invited to say so

text.label: Text: One tap to the right platform. No hunting, n…
text.value: At the right moment, once you have earned it, they are asked for a review or a short testimonial. One tap and they are on the page. No hunting for the link, no signing in, no hassle.

text.label: Text: 04
Heading: And you hear the unhappy ones first
text.value: On Google, and wherever else your audience checks

text.label: Text: Anyone can leave a public review either way.…
text.value: The review goes where it does you the most good: your Google listing first, then the other places people look you up before they buy. Anybody can leave whatever they want, wherever they want. We are not standing in the way of that, and no honest system does.

text.label: Text: 05
Heading: It repeats
Text: Every customer, every time, without anyone a…
text.value: Every student, every client, from now on. This is what everybody who sells what they know should already be doing, and almost nobody does, because it is one more thing to remember. Now it is not.

props.text: The ask goes out while they are still happy.
Not three days later when somebody remembers. The moment a student finishes the program, the message is already gone.

props.caption: An illustration of the flow, not a client's real thread. Nobody on your team has to remember to send it, and nobody has to feel awkward asking.

messages.text: Hi Dana, congratulations on finishing the program. If it helped you, would you mind leaving a quick review? Takes about thirty seconds.
Happy to. Send me the link?
Right here. Thank you, it genuinely helps a small team like ours.

props.text: And then they belong on your own website.

Now the part nobody thinks about. You earned those reviews. Right now they live on a page that also lists other people who teach what you teach, so the proof you worked years for is doing its selling inside somebody else's shopping list.
Your rating sits beside everybody else's, with a map and a list of options. The buyer is comparing. That is what the page is built to make them do.
The same reviews, pulled in and kept current, with nobody else on the screen, next to your story, your program and a button that books the call. Nothing to compare against.
Both, ideally. The profile is how they find you. Your site is where the reviews finish the job.
